items.name: 9 degree grooved iPad base
items.selection_reason: 9 degree wedge, 180 x 127.953544 mm plan footprint (M4 11-inch body ratio); slope length 129.548501 mm. Terrace 36 mm long, 7 mm deep. Ten capsule grip grooves 168 x 2.5 mm, depth 1 mm, pitch 7.5 mm, end radius 1.25 mm. Retain iPad insertion channel and exterior R3.

risks.description: Channel dimensions are editable defaults. Exact iPad/case fit, load capacity and tip resistance require physical verification; no specific iPad model is certified.
